ruleset.name: WPHEKA Quality all sniffs
ruleset.description:
The WordPress Coding Standards, applied whole.
Selected with --all-sniffs. Use it when the question is "does this conform to WPCS", for example before a wordpress.org submission or when preparing a formatting pass with phpcbf.
Do not use it to look for defects. It reports layout alongside behaviour and, on a codebase that has not been formatted to WPCS, thousands of indentation findings will bury the handful that describe a real problem. That is the reason config/phpcs-default.xml is the default.
